title: Secondaries Are Essential
primary_theme: Venture secondaries as a response to longer private-company duration
founder_lessons: Plan for longer private company lifecycles because startups and funds now often stay illiquid much longer.
Understand that low-cost experimentation and small early checks changed the structure of seed investing.
Secondaries are not one market; strategy and underwriting vary across fund, company, and geography.
Look beyond momentum markets for overlooked opportunities with better valuations.
